name: Moravian Serbia
events: Balša II succeeds his brother, Durađ I, as ruler of Lower Zeta in what is now Montenegro.
Balša II of Zeta conquers Albania.
Helena Dragaš, a descendant of King Stefan III Dečanski of Serbia, marries the Byzantine Emperor Manuel II…
The semi-independent Serbian state (sanjak) of Uskup is annexed by the Ottoman Empire and General Pasha…
